svg.title: MarkeTech frontend: how the skeleton starts and renders
svg.desc: A command in the terminal makes npm read package.json and start the Vite dev server, which reads vite.config.ts. The browser then requests index.html, whose script tag loads main.ts; main.ts imports Vue and App.vue and mounts the component into the div with id app. Separately, vue-tsc checks the types using tsconfig.json, and the build command produces static files in dist.
svg.text: How the skeleton starts and renders: which file calls which, and in what order. Follow the numbers 1 to 7.
